objective: Build a provider-neutral SystemVerification module that deterministically verifies one immutable fully integrated system candidate against approved system-level functional and quality obligations without granting business acceptance.
constraints: Core owns candidate binding, obligation expansion, policy evaluation, outcome selection, checkpoint replay, and progression.
Verifier adapters may report raw observations and native evidence only.
BusinessAcceptance remains a separate downstream Core Gate.
The V1 slice must be releasable within the active eight-hour completion window.
acceptanceCriteria: Exact version-pinned inputs produce byte-identical obligations, evaluation, diagnostics, result, and traceability proposal.
Every approved system-level acceptance criterion and applicable non-functional requirement has an explicit satisfied, failed, or missing-evidence disposition.
Only passing policy evaluation may produce verified and permit BusinessAcceptanceGate progression.
Baseline, repository, integration-fact, evidence, adapter, and policy substitution fail closed.
Traceability adds forward factual AcceptanceCriterion to Evidence links only after verified evaluation.
